# Daily reconciliation against the raw click log

> Every day at 02:30, `reconcileDay` recounts each billed hour of the previous day from the raw click log and fixes any difference with a charge or an `ADJUSTMENT` journal.

_Part of [Aggregating and billing ad clicks](ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md)_

The hourly job bills from fast streaming aggregates. Those can be off, or can miss an hour. So a daily job, `ads.reconcile-day` (cron `30 2 * * *`), treats the raw click log as the source of truth. `reconcileDay` lives in [`AdBillingJobs`](ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md). It is scheduled in `onApplicationBootstrap`. First it asks `ClickHouse` for the exact count of valid clicks per campaign and hour from `ad_clicks_raw`, for one whole day. By default that day is yesterday (UTC). A `day` value in the payload picks another day. Then it looks up each campaign-hour in the `AdBillingRun` table. See [Exact valid-click count per campaign and hour from the raw log](exact-click-query.md) and [Decision: charge, adjust or skip each billed hour](compare-with-billing-run.md). There are two outcomes. If no `AdBillingRun` row exists, the stream path missed the hour, so it calls [`charge`](hourly-billing.md) with the exact count. If a row exists, was never reconciled, and has a different click count, [`adjust`](adjust-journal.md) corrects it. Matching hours and hours already reconciled are skipped. The job returns how many hours it changed.

**Look at:** [ad-billing.jobs.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/infra/ad-billing.jobs.ts) · [ad-billing.jobs.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/infra/ad-billing.jobs.ts)

## Pieces

- Daily reconcile job for the previous day: The `ads.reconcile-day` handler runs at 02:30, defaults to yesterday and loops over every campaign-hour with raw clicks.
- [Exact valid-click count per campaign and hour from the raw log](exact-click-query.md): A `ClickHouse` query on `ad_clicks_raw FINAL` counts rows with `valid = 1`, grouped by campaign and start of hour.
- [Decision: charge, adjust or skip each billed hour](compare-with-billing-run.md): Compares the exact count with the `AdBillingRun` row: missing means charge, unreconciled and different means adjust, anything else is left alone.
- [Correction of one hour with an ADJUSTMENT journal](adjust-journal.md): `adjust` marks the run as reconciled and posts a ledger journal worth the click difference times the price per click.

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| database | `ad_clicks_raw (ClickHouse)` | Read with `FINAL` to count valid clicks per campaign and hour, the source of truth for the day. |
| database | `AdBillingRun` | Read to see what was billed per campaign and hour. `adjust` writes `reconciledClicks` and `adjustmentJournalId`, and `charge` inserts missing rows. |
| database | `AdCampaign` | Read in `adjust` for the owning shop and the price per click (`cpcCents`). |
| job | `ads.reconcile-day` | Cron `30 2 * * *`, concurrency 1, payload `{ day?: string }`. |
| other | `Ledger journal kind ADJUSTMENT` | Posted by `adjust` between the shop account and `LEDGER_ACCOUNTS.PLATFORM_FEES`. |

## Also relies on

- [Recording money in the ledger](../domain-payments/recording-money-in-ledger.md) (domain/payments): `adjust` posts its `ADJUSTMENT` journal through `LedgerService.post` inside the same transaction.

## Watch out

- Only hours with at least one raw click are visited. An hour billed from the stream that has no raw clicks is never corrected.
- Each hour is adjusted at most once. `reconciledClicks` must be `NULL`, and the update guards on that, so later changes to the raw log are ignored.
- A missed hour goes through `charge`, so it is still capped by the campaign's daily budget. An `adjust` is not capped.
- The sign of the journal follows the click difference. Under-billed hours take money from the shop, over-billed hours refund it. If the count differs but the amount is zero, the run is marked reconciled and nothing is posted.
